notes.content:
Greetings to all commanders!
Today, the “Big Engineerr” of the Weapons Department would like to announce that [b]【Endless Mode】[/b] is officially open!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/cd14eb08e39e9c538520d052f907624e719e55f0.jpg[/img]

During this long wait, the “Big Engineerr have not been idle and have prepared a series of exciting new content for the commanders:

[b]【New Character】[/b]

[b]"Tiny" Omar[/b]
Skill：Forcibly enhance the performance of power armor, significantly increasing movement speed, attack speed, and defense in a short period of time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/0a6951338a3e78b4cea6606da449e0ac0eaf9dcf.png[/img]

[b]【New Weapon】[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/a86c1886f5fc33566ce31c46832503ac2173f3d7.png[/img]
[b]Satellite Cannon：[/b]Links to an ancient orbital satellite, delivering devastating strikes from above。

[b]【New Legacies】[/b]

[b]Time-Walker Mage[/b]（Link with[i]Time-Walker[/i]）：The mage dispatched by the Timewalker team to support the wormhole crisis will transform into floating cannons during battles and float beside the agents to shoot at the enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/97660043b08220740fec6c6ceea518ff1c784ed9.png[/img]

[b]Health Type A：[/b]Life cap provides higher attack power to the weapon, the higher the life cap, the higher the increase in attack power
[b]Counterweight Stabilizer：[/b]The higher the weight, the higher the storm probability.
[b]Energizer Type A：[/b]The energy cap provides the weapon with a higher attack speed; the higher the energy value, the faster the attack speed.
[b]Counterforce Chip：[/b]When a counterattack is triggered, the Floating Cannon fires 4 bullets around it for 100 damage (damage increases with level).
[b]Deterrent Chip：[/b]When Deterrence is triggered, the Floating Cannon applies a Deterrence effect to the surrounding area for 1s (Deterrence time increases with level).
[b]Crystal Energy：[/b]Crystallization feeds the weapon, and the higher the stock, the higher the damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/096969b6e92154fa6a780905a36d4f29d01d2839.png[/img]

[b]【New Monsters】[/b]

Stingers, Wings, Dissolver
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/99036816c44b60d8542b38bd3a8c85ca3934703a.png[/img]

[b]【New Boss】[/b]

Destruction, Cracks
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/3e1a35d38063ddcffeeb1466aefa4a515e404e46.png[/img]

notes.title: Powerful alliance! Wizard from "Timewalker: Dark World" arrive at the wormhole!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/25c5df203e3df5162922022fc719dcb29a6a5eb9.jpg[/img]

Greetings, commanders! Today, the “Big engineer” of the Weapons Department would like to announce that after countless days and nights of careful polishing, our HQ ship is about to be equipped with a brand new power system, and will be heading to the next timeline at full speed--[b]【Endless Mode】[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/cd14eb08e39e9c538520d052f907624e719e55f0.jpg[/img]

In the following, the weapons, heroes, and more of [b]Time Treker[/b] and [b]Timewalker: Dark World[/b] will open the door to interoperability and support the battlefronts respectively!

We've also got a little something for commanders, and will be drawing five lucky winners of a [i]Timewalker: Dark World[/i] KEY in the comments section under this announcement!

[b]【Activity time】[/b]
Now through November 20th
[b]【Prizes in this period】[/b]
[i]Timewalker: Dark World[/i] One Game KEY
[b]【Number of Winners】[/b]
  5

*After the event is over, we will send a private message to the lucky winners on STEAM and distribute the rewards within 7 working days, so stay tuned~!

In addition to this, our  “Big Engineer” has prepared a series of exciting new content for all the cadres, which will be released on the day of the official release~!

Three days later, the doors to the official release will open for you. Please prepare yourselves for a more challenging battle!

notes.title: V0.8.2Upadte | New technologies arrive!
notes.content:
Commanders, long time no see. I am an engineer affiliated with the headquarters' arsenal. During this time, I have been working tirelessly and have developed a new technology - the "Potential Upgrade"!

Unlike the traditional way where only survival, combat, dexterity, and concentration can be enhanced by adding points, the "Potential Upgrade" customizes a unique plan for each commander to better showcase their specialties. Based on this, commanders can upgrade various modules in the plan to strengthen your mechas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/61e2153f0f490460beb883cde2ad1bb474488ab4.png[/img]【"Veteran" McNulty】

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/f2884b0147fde041458242393a669cb62f7ea9a0.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/6da0d3b4ce3c4b4c19013c22fa3ba2cd64a5fa12.png[/img]【"Rebel" Meve】

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/f3755e56d3cca89fb0c1e2015fb7911912d8f562.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/5478d2f948dcb6df642a15c925de395640191382.png[/img]【"Genius" Alexa】

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/6084633d9949fa6ec35230b46a5a60f764d8593b.png[/img]

[b]【More Attribute Enhancements】[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/fd2cb83ea122047f62bbc4154e05f932e553a13d.png[/img]
【Aggressive Neurotoxin】、【Rebellion Neurotoxin】、【Reflex Neurotoxin】、【Active Neurotoxin】
These Neurotoxins can enhance the ability of the commanders, but be aware of its side effects~!

[b]【New Legacy】[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/ceaa31cfef2fb127d4d7541e243e11ab098adb4a.png[/img]
【Orbiting Satellite】 【Black Dice】 【Vortex Edge】 【Longshot Ring】
Provide different buffs to yourself and debuffs to enemies.

[b]【New Hero Coming Soon】[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/8171973f954444cfe93643404bc81e17e4517b12.png[/img]
Bug girl with unique skills... Just waiting for the next update!

[b]In this timeline operation, we have fixed the following issues:[/b]
*Fixed the problem of incorrect damage frequency of "Graviton Cannon" and "Electrostastic Controller" (the previous damage calculation method was incorrect).
* Fixed the problem of incomplete display of boss illustrations.
* Fixed the problem of display on the research center interface.
* Fixed the problem of ineffective refresh discounts in "Construction Levels".
*Fixed the problem of uncounted "Survival Expert" cumulative achievement.
* Fixed the problem that completing "Last Stand" multiple times in the same level but only recording the achievement once.

[b]Content experience optimization:[/b]
 *Added a "speed-up function" in the game.
*Optimized the problem of lag when there are too many enemies.
*Added the recycling function of inheritance and enhanced attributes.
*Added the one-click upgrade function in the warehouse.
*Added the display switch for the announcer lady and character text bubbles.
*Optimized the balance of weapons.
*Increased the number of enemies (especially in early levels).
*Increased the damage caused by late-stage enemies to characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/edf43a1f28c2e791244cc9c701784ebc740d37ae.png[/img]

notes.title: File Decryption | Use the Optical Lens to blind the bugs!
notes.content:
Feeling a little intimidated by the darkness of the battlefield? Optical lenses can help you purge the darkness!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/a8b08d0e6da06f79a4b26edfc18423bf2c1f2b4e.png[/img]

Optical lenses can enhance the light intensity and waveform of searchlights and flares. Similarly it can be mounted on lighting towers to help defend against xenomorphs more efficiently.
[b]Equipment Effect: (LV1) Lighted areas deal +8 damage per second (lighting tower area, flare area, main character light area)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/f6459afeb791a72917f81e15d1a0673ec452fced.gif[/img]

[Archive] We were on a cleanup mission on a planet in the S-19 timeline when we discovered a modified lighting tower. Someone had adjusted the intensity and waveform of the light with a very sophisticated optical lens to help the lighting tower defend against the xenomorphs more efficiently. With our current technology we were unable to cut and polish such a perfect lens, so after cleaning up the planet we took the lens back. After all, there was no longer any point in leaving it on this long-deserted planet, so we might as well let it continue to shine on the battlefield.

notes.title: The free trial version is now available! Welcome to play!
notes.content:
Introduction to worldview:
After the "mass extinction", the earth is covered in black fog, and the humans who fled the earth have launched the "TimeTrecker" project, 
sending elites through the "time and space wormhole" to return to the past to prevent the catastrophe from happening,
the characters you operate need to turn the tide of the war, rewrite the timeline, and save the world before the "mass extinction" happens.

Main features:
■ Featured heroes: Unlock different heroes, a variety of hero skills, so that each play has a different experience
■ Custom weapons: A variety of weapons and plug-ins for you to combine at will, you can match your favorite weapon system to save the world
■ Random branch missions: Explore, annihilate, survive, defend and other branch missions, each time is a new challenge.
■ One more round: Rich achievement points waiting for you to unlock, achievement points can strengthen the hero in the main base, simplify the difficulty of the game, let you fight more brave in the game.

If you are interested in games, you can download the trial version to play first

The demo includes:
■ You can choose a hero to complete a battle zone, including boss level and hidden level.
■ Levels include random branch missions, map support pods.
■ Boosts attributes for characters.
■ Includes all weapons, plugins, items and stat boosts and other random content.
■ You can obtain some in-game achievement points and activate some additional abilities.

Note: The demo savedata cannot be used for the official version!

If you think it is fun, please add to wishlist, your support is our continuous development motivation.

Future official releases will include:
■ Endless mode, unlimited combat.
■ 6 playable heroes and their own skills.
■ Complete drama theater flow, and more random maps.
■ More different monsters, different bosses.
■ More new weapons, plugins, items and other random content.
■ Earn all achievement points to activate more abilities and make fighting easier.
